editorialTitle: The Developer's Guide to Code Formatting
editorialP1: Code formatting is not a cosmetic concern — it is a professional standard. Unformatted SQL queries, minified JSON payloads, and collapsed XML documents are among the most common sources of bugs that go undetected during code review. When whitespace and indentation are removed, the human eye struggles to parse the logical structure of a query, often missing issues like incorrect JOIN conditions, mismatched brackets, or accidental cross-joins that could return millions of unexpected rows.
editorialP2: Pretty Format was built on the belief that every developer deserves access to world-class formatting tools without compromises. Unlike many online tools that send your code to a remote server for processing — exposing potentially sensitive schema information, API secrets embedded in JSON payloads, or proprietary query logic — all of Pretty Format's processing runs entirely within your browser using native JavaScript APIs. This architecture means your data is private by design, not by policy.
editorialCard1Desc: SQL remains the most widely-used data language in the world, powering everything from small startups to Fortune 500 data warehouses. Our SQL formatter supports all major dialects including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server (T-SQL), Oracle (PL/SQL), and BigQuery.
editorialCard2Desc: JSON is the backbone of modern APIs and configuration files. Our formatter validates, beautifies, and optionally minifies JSON, helping you quickly understand deeply nested data structures and catch syntax errors before they reach production.
editorialCard3Desc: XML remains the standard for enterprise systems, SOAP APIs, Android manifests, and countless configuration formats. Our XML formatter handles complex namespaces, CDATA sections, and DTD declarations, giving you clean, readable output every time.
